## Not for Nigeria (verified)
- Scale AI crowd work / Remotasks: closed in NG (Rest of World, 2024) — no new signups.
- Amazon MTurk, Sama, CloudFactory, Hive: NG not recruitable (or East-Africa focus).
- Prolific: official participant country list excludes NG (PayPal-rail limitation); some NG guides over-claim.
- Surge AI: US-based only.

## Payout rails that work from Nigeria
- PayPal (receive): most platforms; FX hit ~3-5%; some cap volume (OneForma US$300/yr → switch to Payoneer).
- Payoneer: best overall; USD balance → NGN at good rate.
- AirTM: USD e-wallet + peer cash-out to NG bank; Outlier/CrowdGen standard.
- Wise: works for Braintrust/Micro1-style rails; NGN receiving can be limited — always test.
- Direct bank: Mercor, Invisible, TELUS — request SWIFT/IBAN.
- Paystack/Flutterwave: NOT used by any legit global platform; any "AI job" charging registration via Paystack = SCAM.

## Entry & norms that recur
- Unpaid qualification assessments on DA/Stellar/Outlier set your rate bracket — quality > speed.
- Alignerr/Micro1 selective; expert domains (operations/logistics, finance, law, code) pay 40-120/hr; facilities/property ops background maps to "AI agent task author (ops/logistics)" roles.
- Never pay to join; free everywhere legit.
